title: Cost-Effective Hydrogen Storage Materials: Utilizing Biogas Slurry to Synthesize High-Performance Hollow porous Carbon Spheres
material_description: CS850-4.5 | hollow porous carbon spheres (cluster-like) from biogas slurry (80 mL) + soluble starch (6 g) with alpha-Fe2O3 (4 g): hydrothermal carbonization 200 °C, 7 h (CFe-HTC); carbonization 800 °C, N2, 2 h; washed with water, 1 mol/L HCl and ethanol (CS); KOH impregnation activation at 850 °C, KOH:CS mass ratio 4.5, 2 h, N2
purification_method: after 800 °C carbonization: washed with deionized water, 1 mol/L HCl and ethanol until filtrate clear (iron removal); after KOH activation: washed, dried and ground
activation_method: KOH impregnation (KOH:CS mass ratio 4.5; ultrasonicated at 95 °C for 30 min), heated to 850 °C under N2, held 2 h
functional_groups: C–OH, C–O, C=O, COOH (FTIR; XPS C 1s/O 1s)
source_location: main-4.png (p. 4), Fig. 4a, series 'CS850-4.5 total (red filled circles)', marker 1 of 17 visible; volumetric capacity from Fig. 4b, series 'CS850-4.5'
